messages:
sasha: Quick flag — p95 for /v1/generate on the latency dashboard jumped to ~820ms at 11:20 but raw traces for the same timeframe show lots of ~200ms. Doesn't add up. :thinking:
kevin: which dashboard link? could be sampling/rollup mix
sasha: https://dashboards.redwood/internal/latency?endpoint=%2Fv1%2Fgenerate&env=prod
sasha: Dashboard shows p50=210, p95=820, p99=1200. Raw traces (filtered by request_id) are mostly p95~230.
kevin: two likely culprits: 1) dashboard is blending rollup origins (some endpoints emit sampled rollups), 2) prefix K/V cache hits are excluded from traces but included in rollup. Can you paste the raw query you used?
sasha: I pulled the panel's underlying query: `SELECT pct(50, latency), pct(95, latency), pct(99, latency) FROM latency_rollups WHERE endpoint="/v1/generate" AND env="prod" GROUP BY 1m`
priya: that panel currently uses the composite rollup stream. We tag rollups with origin but UI doesn't surface it. If some shards send `origin=proxy-cache` and others `origin=full-trace`, pct calc will mix them. Docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/telemetry/rollups
kevin: aha. also check sample_count on the rollup rows — if count is low (<50) p95 will be noisy.
sasha: sample_count is like 18 for a few 1m buckets around the spike. so unstable for sure.
emma: another subtle thing: our trace exporter drops cached responses before export to tracing to save volume, but rollups include cached latencies (they come from nginx logs). That can shift percentiles if not annotated.
joel: FYI telemetry-bot started a metadata reingest last week to backfill `sample_source` on older rollups, might help correlate.
telemetry-bot: reingest-job scheduled: job_id=ri-2026-03-20-19, status=queued. Will backfill sample_source for 30d of rollups.
priya: UX suggestion — show a small provenance pill in the percentile tooltip: e.g. `origin=full-trace | sampled_count=18 | cache_hits=12` with a link "View raw traces" that pre-filters the traces explorer. That would make it obvious when pct values are from mixed sources.
sasha: strong +1 to provenance pill. right now it's too easy to misinterpret p95 as single-source truth. Can we also make the panel surface the sample_count?
kevin: I'll take a quick UI patch to add the pill and sample_count if the API exposes `sample_source` and `sample_count` in the rollup response. tagging @priya as owner of rollup API schema.
priya: we can add `sample_source` + `sample_count` to the rollup response; there's a small migration but doable. I'll create a PR for the API change and coordinate with metrics ingest team.
sasha: great — thanks both. Can someone add this as a subtask on the rollout dashboard epic? avoids re-opening the same confusion for other endpoints.
kevin: will add the UX task and link the API PR.
sasha: awesome, thanks. :thumbsup:
